tools.name: read_flight_mission
tools.description: Read the active flight mission, its exact purchasing limits, current state, and safe booking status.

tools.name: revoke_purchase_authority
tools.description: Revoke the active mission authority so future purchase attempts are denied.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search the challenge flight inventory using the active mission. The caller cannot expand the stored route or spending authority.

tools.name: tighten_flight_mission
tools.description: Make the active mission safer or narrower. The agent may lower the price cap, require an earlier arrival, reduce connections, or require refundability, but can never expand its authority.
